items.special_treatment:
- The best HHDH variant (from Ilumatobacter coccineus, IcHheG) in whole cell form was used as biocatalyst.
- Reaction conditions for high yield: 200 mM cyclohexene oxide, 400 mM NaOCN, 50 g/L wet cell, 35% (v/v) ethyl acetate, pH self-regulated at 10.5, 25°C, 16-29 h.
- At pilot scale (10 L), isolated yield was 87% after post-processing (extraction, crystallization).
- Enantiomeric excess (ee) of product: 53%.
- No additional buffer required due to self-pH control by ethyl acetate hydrolysis.
- Reaction is exothermic at scale (>35°C), temperature controlled at 25°C.
- Product: trans-hexahydro-2(3H)-benzoxazolone (trans-HBC).
- Analytical yield (GC): up to 95%.
- Isolated yield (after DSP): 87%.
